summary: Frontend-only test of the two new auth enhancements on /auth (mobile viewport 390x844). Password strength meter (SIGNUP-only) and 'Stay signed in' remember toggle both work end-to-end. All regression flows (password eye toggle, welcome toast on Learn, demo login → root/Learn tab) pass. One spec/implementation mismatch found: two of the 'Medium' example passwords in the request ('Abcdefgh', 'abc12345') actually render as 'Weak' because the passwordScore() helper only awards 1 point per category, so they score 2 → weak (medium requires score===3). Every other listed example matches the spec exactly.
action_items: Review passwordScore() thresholds in /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx (lines 24-31, 227). Review request lists 'Abcdefgh' and 'abc12345' as MEDIUM examples, but they currently render as WEAK (each scores 2 — length>=8 + one other category — while medium requires score===3). Decide whether to (a) relax the medium threshold to score>=2 so those cases show 2 amber bars + 'Medium', or (b) accept the stricter algorithm and update the reviewer/user-facing examples so 'Medium' really needs three categories (e.g. 'Abcdefg1' or 'abcd!123', both of which currently do show Medium correctly). This is the only deviation from the requested behaviour.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx (line 64,82,95): tq_remember is written before the auth network call — good, but if the login itself fails the flag is still persisted with the latest toggle state. Low-impact but worth noting; consider writing tq_remember only inside the success branch, or accept the current behaviour as intentional (flag purely tracks the user's toggle preference, not auth success).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo@tradequest.app / demo123 account which already existed in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth screen testIDs verified working on web preview: auth-heading, toggle-auth-mode, email-input, password-input, toggle-password, password-strength (signup+pw>0 only), remember-toggle, auth-submit-button, google-login-button, forgot-password-link, auth-disclaimer-link. Web storage: AsyncStorage on web falls through to localStorage under key 'tq_remember' (JSON-serialised: 'true' / 'false'). Onboarding gate appears first on cold load — click [data-testid="onboarding-skip"] to reach /auth.
rca_of_issue: Password strength label mismatch RCA: passwordScore(p) in /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx L24-31 awards +1 for each of {length>=8, mixed case, has digit, has symbol}. Bucketing at L227: score<=2 → weak, score===3 → medium, score===4 → strong. 'Abcdefgh' satisfies length + mixed case only (score 2 → weak). 'abc12345' satisfies length + digit only (score 2 → weak). Both examples in the review request expected Medium, but only three-category passwords currently reach that bucket. Everything else — hidden in login, hidden with empty pw, 1 red bar+Weak for 'abc', 3 green bars+Strong for 'Abc123!xyz', plus Medium correctly triggered for 'Abcdefg1' and 'abcd!123' — matches spec exactly.
